Solution: Let x be the number. Translate both sides: 3x + 8 = 2x + 19. Subtract 2x and 8: x = 11. Check: 3(11) + 8 = 41 and 2(11) + 19 = 41.

Hints: Let the integers be n, n + 1, and n + 2.
